answer: Every new identity is handed a honeypot task whose correct answer is already known. The node compares the submission against that answer before it grants any trust, and it tallies trust per task, not per address, capped each epoch so volume cannot replace accuracy. An honest worker on a mesa of repetitive jobs climbs the same ledge as everyone else, one measured result at a time. A farm that scripts the queue fails the planted items and gets flagged. Seeding each honeypot costs a few copper in compute, far less than the weeks a farm wastes discovering its answers were the test.
